Recorded claim:
D211558 added browser_ext_compose_details.js and browser_ext_compose_details_mv3.js coverage for encryption state. A reviewer could not tell which checkWindow was in the extension and which callback inspected the native compose window; the accepted code uses checkNativeWindow for the cross-context message. Current tests retain that name, a named test_selectedEncryptionTechnology task, and explicit identities such as smimeAndOpenPGPIdentity. Duplicated MV2/MV3 cases were accepted with a suggestion to share code; treat that suggestion as open review advice, not an established ban on duplicate tests.
